facts.fact: The OGP Independent Reporting Mechanism says the Sierra Leone Parliament mobile app and website allow only one-way communication from parliament to the public, that the public can currently engage only through social media or in person, and that most of the 80 laws, treaties and agreements passed in 2023 were not subject to citizen participation.
